operational.subject: The first combined environment and admission-file inspection returned an empty projection.
operational.recovery: Use literal scalar environment and existence checks, then invoke the registered admitted-model check directly.

operational.subject: A combined target-branch, worktree and drive inventory stopped projecting after an empty branch result.
operational.recovery: Use a structured for-each-ref inventory and a separate literal target-path check.

operational.subject: A scalar branch-reference and disk-space PowerShell probe returned no usable output.
operational.recovery: Avoid the nonzero show-ref path and collect branch refs with an exit-zero for-each-ref query.

operational.subject: A simplified target-path and drive-space PowerShell probe also returned no usable output.
operational.recovery: Use a literal command-shell path check, then return to one structured PowerShell object after removing the failing native command.

operational.subject: A command-shell Git probe passed a quoted repository path literally and Git rejected the path.
operational.recovery: Do not use that cross-shell quoting form; use PowerShell native argument arrays and literal-path APIs.

operational.subject: A multiline command-shell directory and branch probe returned no usable projection.
operational.recovery: Use one structured PowerShell command with exit-zero Git enumeration and JSON output.

operational.subject: The first complete Coordinator skill read through Get-Content returned an empty projection.
operational.recovery: Read the exact UTF-8 file with the runtime file API and verify its byte length first.

operational.subject: The first primary-board marker read through the runtime file API returned an empty projection.
operational.recovery: Use a literal command-shell type operation to read the small marker exactly.

operational.subject: A follow-up primary-board marker metadata probe also returned no usable projection.
operational.recovery: Treat the exact successful marker content as controlling and avoid another redundant wrapper.

operational.subject: The first Coordinator list invocation used a command-shell quoted absolute script path that was interpreted relative to the current directory.
operational.recovery: Invoke the same installed helper with PowerShell native argument handling; the board then listed zero active claims.

operational.subject: The first phase-script patch wrapper evaluated a literal plugin-root placeholder and failed before creating the file.
operational.recovery: Bind the dollar-brace placeholder as patch data, reapply once, and verify every code file with the JavaScript parser.

operational.subject: A broad source-manifest replay crossed its output boundary after planning, x1 and x2 were verified but before final-seal completion was projected.
operational.recovery: Retain the partial wrapper and replay only the unverified final content-seal slice; all 133 entries then matched without source execution.

operational.subject: The first planning-only invocation rejected Git's collapsed untracked owner-directory row as a foreign startup change before creating stage artifacts.
operational.recovery: Permit only the exact phase prefix or a Git-collapsed ancestor of that prefix while continuing to reject every unrelated path.

operational.subject: The first exact planning-review wrapper embedded privacy regular expressions in an inline JavaScript command and failed lexical parsing before any review result was produced.
operational.recovery: Move the unchanged checks into a literal external TXT validator, validate its syntax, and refresh only the planning Method Flow and manifest metadata.

operational.subject: The first literal planning validator reported the phase scanner's own exact delegation-marker regex as a candidate payload hit.
operational.recovery: Split the scanner-definition token while preserving the same runtime pattern, then rerun the bounded planning validator after refreshing only Method Flow and manifest metadata.

operational.subject: The first planning commit placed the message option after the pathspec terminator, so Git rejected the option and message as unknown paths before creating a commit.
operational.recovery: Retain the unchanged staged set, refresh the planning Method Flow and manifest, restage only those refreshed files, and place the message option before the pathspec terminator.

preparation_failure.subject: The first correction guard parsed porcelain after a helper trimmed its leading status column.
preparation_failure.recovery: Read raw porcelain bytes and accept only the exact owner prefix or its collapsed ancestor.
